reading.title: Life on a Mountain
reading.purpose: Learn how a mountain changes from bottom to top and how people and weather affect it.
paras: A tall mountain has many homes for living things, from the bottom to the top. If you ascend it, you will see the world change with every step. If you descend, you will see it change back.

At the bottom, food and water are abundant. Trees grow thick, and many animals live there. Higher up, it gets colder and windier. Trees become small and then stop growing at all. Food is scarce, so only tough plants and animals can live near the top.

People have used mountains for a very long time. Some mountain trails are ancient, because people have walked them for hundreds of years. Modern hikers have lighter boots, warm jackets, and maps on their phones.
Mountains change, too. Water seeps into cracks in rock. When the water freezes, it will expand and push the crack wider. Over many winters, the rock can split.

Reaching the top of a mountain feels like a victory. But when dark clouds roll in, it is obvious that the weather is changing, and a smart climber turns back. That is not a defeat. A safe trip is the best goal.

choices: hard to find during any season of the entire year
covered with snow and ice for the whole year long
too old for anyone to use in a safe way again
plentiful, with more than enough to go around
qs.why: The next sentences show plenty at the bottom: trees grow thick and many animals live there.

qs.q: Which sentence tells what happens when water freezes in a crack?
choices: Water seeps into cracks in rock.
When the water freezes, it will expand and push the crack wider.
Over many winters, the rock can split.
qs.why: This sentence tells what the freezing water does inside the crack: it expands and pushes the crack wider.

ev.text: When the water freezes, it will expand and push the crack wider.

qs.q: Why can only tough plants and animals live near the top of a mountain?
choices: Food is scarce and the weather is cold and windy.
Trees there grow so thick that they block out the light.
Ancient travelers cleared away all of the plants long ago.
Water is abundant there, so the small plants get washed away.
qs.why: The reading says it is colder and windier higher up, trees stop growing, and food is scarce.

qs.q: What is the main idea of this reading?
choices: Climbers who turn back from a mountain have always lost the climb.
Modern hikers are always safer than ancient travelers because they carry phones.
A mountain changes from bottom to top, and climbers watch the weather.
Rocks on mountains split because climbers walk across them every single winter.
qs.why: The reading describes the changing layers of a mountain and ends with advice to turn back when the weather changes.

clues.text: Trees grow thick, and many animals live there.
so only tough plants and animals can live near the top
because people have walked them for hundreds of years

reading.retellFrame: As you ascend a mountain, ___ becomes scarce, and a smart climber ___.

needsReview.reason: Says some mountain trails have been walked for hundreds of years. This is true of many trails, but no specific trail is named; a person may want to name one if desired.
